summary: Registered 2026-10-04 to prove Amendment 12's generational runner, on the module default model claude-haiku-4-5. The first proposal raised ModelSubstituted: the gateway answered with gemini-3.1-pro-preview, which docs/setup/MODEL-ACCESS.md records as what haiku does at our ~167,000-character proposal prompt.
